text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since summer training 
camp began. Training with Epiphaneia 
starts in the early morning—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer!!
choice_data_list:
Good morning. You're full of energy in the 
morning too.

Good morning. You're full of energy in the 
morning too.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Morning, noon, and night—I'm 
full of energy all the time!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"My head is clear, and I can do anything! 
Alright, let's start training!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She diligently works through all the 
special summer camp routines. Then, taking 
some time in the afternoon—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Brilliant, Shion, you look just like a 
fairy! So supple and beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~? How many times are you gonna say 
that~~? Jeez~~.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's start the lesson! Today, 
we're gonna master that movement from 
earlier!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being conscious of the power flowing 
through her entire body and controlling 
that explosive force—for that purpose, she 
was learning how to move her body through 
ballet.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer. Ready to go?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Then, position number 2, please.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, your body's still pretty stiff. Let's 
put a little more effort into stretching!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How did I end up taking ballet lessons 
too? That goes back to right after the 
lesson started—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Since the goal this time is to learn how 
to use your body through ballet, we're 
gonna thoroughly drill the basics!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Epi-san, have you ever seen a ballet? Even 
just a video or whatever works.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: There is one!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I had friends around me who took ballet 
lessons, so I got invited to recitals 
pretty often.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I love performances that use the whole 
body! I still go see them even now!
choice_data_list:
(Epi really is a proper young lady from a 
good family, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So, you get the gist of ballet movements 
then. Basically, I'm planning to 
thoroughly repeat one single movement over 
and over.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, you'll start to understand how 
your body moves from the inside, and 
through that, you'll perceive the flow of 
power.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Nice to meet ya!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Alright, hold that pose! ...Man, your core 
really is great. You've got great 
flexibility too.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
You're just not mindful enough all the way 
to your fingertips. Put your strength in 
with a supple touch...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Supple and graceful!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Argh! I just can't help tensing up!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, Epi-san, you're totally not 
cut out for ballet.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm not trying to say it's sloppy! But 
isn't there a better training method?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I can do this!! The voice of 
destiny says so too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Above all, Trainer told me that this is 
what I need right now!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to believe, and their voices 
gave me a push! So I'll do it, I'll see it 
through to the end! I'm counting on you, 
Shion!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, since I took the job, I'm more 
than happy to teach you, though!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia believes in my training regimen 
and is working hard at it.
choice_data_list: (Can't I be of more help, too...?)

(I wonder if there's any way I could be of 
more help, too...?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, yeah, yeah, like that. A bit more 
like... threading a string through your 
fingertips...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Like this?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're clenching your fists! Man, 
teaching someone is so hard...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: To Trainer? Sure, I don't mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—That's it, lookin' good, Trainer! That's 
exactly what I mean by being aware of your 
fingertips!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Internalizing what I learned from Win 
Variation. And then, translating it so 
Epiphaneia can understand—
choice_data_list:
Imagine balancing a droplet of water on 
the tip of your middle finger.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ! I see, so like this!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! That really changed things!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Epi-san's Trainer. I'd 
never be able to come up with phrasing 
like that.
choice_data_list: Can I join the lesson, too?
Mind if I join the lesson, too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I know best what words and actions will 
reach Epiphaneia. If we take lessons 
together, I should be able to support her.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!! So I get to learn alongside 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
One person, two people, makes no 
difference to me, so I'm totally fine with 
it. But... wouldn't that just be 
exhausting for you?
choice_data_list: It's fine! I'm in your hands!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, starting the next day, I began 
taking ballet lessons with her, supporting 
her by breaking down the movements so 
Epiphaneia could understand.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, Trainer. I'll leave the 
translation to you.
choice_data_list:
Imagine placing a jewel just below your 
navel!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Like this?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, your core is totally aligned now! It 
feels way better than before!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I feel like I need a bit more 
finesse, y'know? Like being conscious down 
to the very last single nerve..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, look at the time. Let's wrap it up 
here for today!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time for solo training! I'm gonna 
learn to be delicate!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then a lesson where we can stay keenly 
aware of every single movement would be 
best. If so, I really want to emphasize 
the basics."
choice_data_list: An adagio lesson that requires strength

A variety of port de bras that take real 
guts

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Adagio refers to performing a sequence of 
movements in a slow, fluid tempo. You use 
your muscular strength to maintain posture 
and meticulously control your movements.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Got it, let's do this!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Slowly... One by one...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To an untrained eye, Epiphaneia's 
movements as she focused looked dynamic 
and beautiful. She is steadily evolving—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "...Yes! Alright, you're next!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Port de bras literally translates to 
'carriage of the arms.' It means executing 
designated movements without losing arm 
posture. Enduring it will cultivate fine 
awareness.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Got it, I'll give it my all! I know I can 
do it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —If it's me...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "I CAN DO IT!!!! WOOOOOOOOO!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her expression and voice were 
boisterous, her form held completely 
steady. There wasn't a hint of clumsiness 
in her movements.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "...Yes! Alright, you're next!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right!! Let's put on some music! It'll 
be way more fun that way♪

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Then dance to the music!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I can play it! I took lessons, after 
all!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to classic ballet, it's 
gotta be music in triple meter! In that 
case...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm reminded once again of just how 
incredible Epiphaneia's upbringing was... 
And as we practice, time slips away—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whew, good work today— ...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Over here!!
choice_data_list:
Epi!? (My muscles are killing me, 
though...!)
Epi!? (My muscles are so sore, though...!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It's festival time!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I've got a feeling something fun's gonna 
happen! Destiny really does love me after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's play! First, superball 
scooping, then takoyaki, yakisoba, and the 
shooting gallery!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yes!! Every single shot hit!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We enjoy various festival stalls to her 
heart's content. Epiphaneia truly is 
exceptional— no matter what she tries, she 
picks up the knack in no time.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Even though it was... the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to give her the result she 
wanted. I will never forget that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And her feelings, still placing her trust 
in me even after all that...
choice_data_list: Thank you for believing in me once more.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'll always believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I am loved by fate! That's why everything 
that happens around me has to have a 
meaning!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain of it, Trainer. The Kikuka 
Sho—everything we've done so far has been 
to win there!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Just like the Satsuki Sho was for Logo, my 
stage is—the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny says so too! All you 
gotta do is believe that, too!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
At the Kikuka Sho, you're going to... 
broaden my destiny! Am I right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Without thinking, I gripped the letter 
of resignation hidden in my breast pocket. 
Someday, I will tear this up and throw it 
away—I will make sure she wins.
